# GardenSmart

> A PBS/ETV gardening television series offering episodes, video tips, and gardening advice for home gardeners.

GardenSmart is an established public television gardening show that provides accessible gardening education through video content, episode archives, and practical gardening tips for viewers of all skill levels.
